sharedIntentRules: Home owns the overall SkyPro product and actual annual/trial offer. The catalog owns discovery and platform filtering.
Each platform detail owns that platform's visible tools, requirements and honest availability. Search-demand validation remains separate from the product-derived candidate map.
Articles answer practical evaluation or setup questions and link to the relevant product detail; do not repeat the same commercial landing page under a new slug.
No country pages unless original localized product/service value and verifiable business facts exist. No hreflang for nonexistent language alternates.
Do not target scheduling, official integration, anti-ban, private-data access or successful extraction as verified SkyPro capabilities without operation evidence.

additionalReview20261023.method: Country-worded web searches, not geolocated Google ranks. Selected primary pages opened directly; all vendor functionality remains a vendor claim, not an independently tested outcome or a SkyPro feature.
